business_problem: Dun & Bradstreet wanted to give procurement teams faster, more comprehensive supplier-risk assessments by combining its large business-data assets with conversational AI and workflow automation instead of forcing analysts through manual, time-consuming evaluations.
solution_summary: IBM Consulting worked with Dun & Bradstreet to create D&B Ask Procurement, an AI assistant that blends Dun & Bradstreet Data Cloud records with IBM's procurement and supplier data. The pilot runs IBM watsonx Orchestrate on IBM Cloud and uses Llama 3 and Mistral large language models to power a conversational interface for supplier-risk analysis. Watsonx Orchestrate supplies both the chat experience and the integration layer that automates repetitive procurement tasks, connects into customer systems, and lets users query large supplier datasets without manual data entry. IBM Garage methods accelerated prototyping, while IBM Expert Labs fine-tuned the AI for specific procurement workflows. The resulting architecture gives procurement users nearly instantaneous 360-degree supplier views covering financials, ownership, ESG factors, fraud potential, and revenue-based scores, plus real-time monitoring that helps them anticipate supplier issues and onboard vendors more quickly.
